title: Calgary SPV-006 Firewall in a Rowhouse with Secondary Suites
code_edition: National Building Code 2023 (Alberta Edition), identified in SPV-006 Figure 1 on PDF p.5; the operative text on pp.1–4 says NBC–Alberta Edition without a year.

facts.text: SPV-006 is dated June 19, 2025; Calgary says CSTIC accepted it on that date.
The operative text names NBC–Alberta Edition Division B Sentences 9.10.11.2(2) and 9.10.13.13(1) without a year; Figure 1 on PDF page 5 is labelled National Building Code 2023 (Alberta Edition).
facts.locator: SPV-006, PDF p.1 (operative text) and p.5, Figure 1

facts.text: Its stated alternative is for designs in rowhouses with secondary suites that include the specified fire-safety features; it says a firewall otherwise required by Sentence 9.10.11.2(2) need not be provided within that scope.

Requirements include separation of exits and dwelling units, prescribed fire-resistance conditions or sprinkler-related exceptions, specified egress provisions, and HVAC duct/fire-damper constraints; drawings must show HVAC system elements listed in the variance.
A site-specific variance to vary the firewall provision requires professional involvement; other acceptable solutions and technical requirements for secondary suites remain to be satisfied.

The separate B23-006 advisory, developed with Calgary Fire Department, addresses triplex/fourplex secondary-suite application completeness and emergency access; it lists responder path/access conditions and is not SPV-006 itself.
Calgary's B23-010 advisory lists alternative solutions among examples where registered professional involvement may be required based on complexity.
PDF page 5 includes an illustrative figure contrasting the NBC 2023(AE) firewall pattern with the SPV-006 fire-separation arrangement; it is a schematic reference, not project-specific drawings.

limitations: SPV-006 and B23-006 are municipal reference materials, not applicant drawings or applications.
B23-006 is an advisory and the City says advisories have no legal status; it does not decide a specific design.
Neither SPV-006 nor B23-006 is a Calgary decision about a particular permit address.
The SPV-006 operative text omits an edition year, while Figure 1 identifies the 2023 Alberta Edition; preserve that locator distinction.

geography.basis: Published municipal guidance is explicitly for Calgary, Alberta; no single project site is claimed.
